name: Tetracycline Phosphate Complex
summary: Tetracycline Phosphate Complex has risk scores for the heart and liver that come from a small computer model rather than tests on people [M][1]. In this computer analysis, the drug received a high risk score of 69 for the liver [M]. It also received a low risk score of 39 for the heart [M]. There are no specific problem reports, similar drug warnings, or FDA notes provided for this drug [1].
